classification.difficultyReason: Transfer the rectangle's height to the triangle using matching ticks, combine their areas, and compare the total with a separately calculated trapezium area. The decomposition and comparison are explicitly prompted.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the area of the rectangle and triangle.

spec.description: An unfilled rectangle on the left and an unfilled right triangle on the right, with aligned lower baselines. Single ticks mark the rectangle's horizontal sides. Double ticks mark both rectangle vertical sides and the triangle's vertical side.
spec.mathematics: The rectangle measures 7 cm by 4 cm. The triangle has base 5 cm and height 4 cm, supplied by matching double ticks. The triangle has a right-angle mark at its lower-left vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and equality marks are visible; calculated areas are in answer fields.

answer.worked:
The matching double ticks give the triangle a height of $4\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{total}}&=4\times7+\frac{1}{2}(4)(5)\\A_{\text{total}}&=28+10\\A_{\text{total}}&=38\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the area of the trapezium using the formula.

spec.description: An unfilled right trapezium with a vertical left edge, shorter horizontal upper base and longer horizontal lower base. Both parallel-side arrows point left. The source has no right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: Parallel sides are 7 cm and 12 cm; the vertical left side supplies the perpendicular height of 4 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given lengths and parallel marks are visible; substitution and calculated area are in answer fields.

answer.worked: Both calculations give $38\text{ cm}^2$. The trapezium has the same area as the rectangle and triangle together.

teachingContext.method: The height is the perpendicular distance between parallel sides.
Two congruent trapeziums form a parallelogram, giving half its area.
Write A=h(a+b)/2, substitute the parallel sides and perpendicular height, then evaluate with square units.

arrangements.description: Parts a and b occupy equal-width columns; part c spans the width below them. There is no shared printed stem.
Rectangle left and triangle right, with aligned lower baselines and meaningful matching side ticks.
